A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Grounding-IQA work, with readable text, equations, algorithms, tables, and figures. Both end with references and contain no appendices, despite referring to supplementary material. Its absence limits comparison of the additional evaluations mentioned in v3.

before.justification: v2 reports original GIQA-Bench evaluations and ablations on box optimization, multitask training, and model compatibility in Tables 2–5.

after.justification: v3 retains the original fine-tuning experiments, ablations, and GIQA-Bench results in Tables 2–5.

M1.justification: The four-stage annotation pipeline, Llama3/Grounding DINO/Q-Instruct components, IQA-Filter and Box-Merge algorithm, coordinate encoding, and supervised fine-tuning procedure remain unchanged. Revised algorithm comments only explain existing steps.

E1.justification: The documented data sources, GIQA-160K, GIQA-Bench, and GIQA-DES/VQA coverage are unchanged. Section 4.3 of v3 newly mentions downstream-task evaluations, but the missing supplementary material prevents establishing their task coverage or whether they were already present in v2.

E2.justification: Table 5 retains the same twelve comparators: four general models, four grounding models, DepictQA-Wild, and three Q-Instruct variants. Tables 2–4 also retain their comparison methods. Removed related-work citations were not evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The documented benchmark samples, evaluation metrics, model configurations, and training settings are unchanged. However, v3 newly references user-study and downstream evaluations without their protocols; the absent supplements prevent determining whether these introduce different evaluation designs.

E4.justification: The box-refinement, coordinate-representation, multitask, and compatibility ablations, box-area analysis, and illustrated cases are unchanged. v3 additionally mentions a user study and downstream applications in Section 4.3, but their unavailable contents prevent verifying added or revised supplementary analyses.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports experimental seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The retained multiple annotation rounds by at least three experts do not introduce a change in uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: All displayed results in Tables 2–5 and the qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 5 retains 22.87 BLEU@4, 63.00 LLM-Score, and 0.7417 total VQA accuracy for Grounding-IQA with mPLUG-Owl2-7B. Outcomes from the newly mentioned supplementary evaluations are unavailable, so additional result changes cannot be established.

T1.justification: The coordinate transformations in Equations 1–2 and the Tag-Recall definition remain unchanged. Neither version contains formal theorems or proofs; shortened token-count explanations do not alter the mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contribution list, and conclusion retain the same grounding-IQA paradigm, GIQA-160K dataset, GIQA-Bench benchmark, and fine-grained assessment claims. Calling the paradigm an extension of existing IQA clarifies the retained contribution scope.

C2.justification: Section 4.2 of v2 observes limited grounding ability from GIQA-VQA-only training. v3 adds the tentative explanation that this arises from reduced contextual information compared with GIQA-DES. This is a new mechanism interpretation without an accompanying new ablation.

D1.justification: The disclosed annotation thresholds, coordinate grid, optimizer parameters, learning rate, warmup, batch size, epochs, four A100-80G GPUs, and project code link remain unchanged. The newly mentioned supplementary evaluations supply no additional implementation instructions.

R1.justification: Section 2 condenses related work and removes six references, including BLIP-2, MiniGPT-4, RankIQA, and FSIM. The central positioning relative to Q-Instruct, Q-Ground, and referring/grounding models remains substantially unchanged.

P1.justification: The title is rephrased, numerical citations become author-year citations, and several passages and captions are shortened or lightly rewritten. The section hierarchy and overall narrative sequence remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 replaces the two-column format with a single-column preprint layout, substantially changing typography, margins, figure and table sizes, and float placement. Several table captions move above their tables, and prose wraps around selected displays. All seven figures and five tables are retained.

improvement.justification: The inspectable revision provides limited clarification, particularly the explanation in Section 4.2, while shortening related work and reducing display sizes. Its method, displayed results, and reproducibility information remain unchanged. The potentially substantive user-study and downstream validation mentioned in Section 4.3 is unavailable, preventing a reliable assessment of the revision's overall quality impact.
